title: Introduce embargoed provenance ledger and microdigest generator
author: Ava Chen
description: Context: customers and internal curation teams have asked for a way to attach time-bound/embargoed metadata to model intake that is cryptographically auditable and gated for release notes. This PR adds a small provenance ledger that signs embargoed metadata, exposes an ACL-aware retrieval path, and generates a compact "microdigest" used by the Console and release automation to show concise delta-first release snippets. Motivation: reduce manual release-note drafting, centralize embargo handling for sensitive commercial or regulatory annotations, and produce deterministic microdigests for downstream QA and changelog automation. Changes: 1) API: intake endpoint accepts optional 'embargo_until' and 'embargo_reason' metadata; embargoed fields are stored encrypted and recorded in the provenance ledger with signer metadata. 2) Ledger: lightweight append-only ledger table with signer_id, signed_hash, ttl and visibility flags; signer service signs using an internal key (KMS-backed) and publishes short receipts. 3) Microdigest generator: new service that computes a compact human-friendly summary from model profile deltas (perf metrics, metadata fields, and affinity hints) and includes risk flags when embargoed fields are present. 4) UI: Console exposes a microdigest preview and marks embargoed items with an eye icon and 'until' date. 5) Migration: DB migration to add ledger table + retention TTL. Checklist: - [x] API schema and intake validation - [x] DB migration (ledger table + indices) - [x] signer service + KMS access scoped - [x] microdigest generator service + deterministic template - [x] Console preview + tests - [x] e2e: onboarding -> draft microdigest -> preview - [x] documentation: registry/embargoed-metadata.md and release-microdigest.md See Linear ENG-4821 for product context and SUP-1234 for a support customer ask. No external schema changes for downstream consumers; microdigest is opt-in during release assembly.

changes_summary: Add provenance ledger for embargoed metadata with KMS-backed signer receipts
Intake API extended with embargo_until and encrypted fields
Microdigest generator: deterministic delta-first summaries and risk flags
Console preview with embargo indicators and signer hover
DB migration and retention policy configurable via registry.provenance.ttl_days
End-to-end tests and docs to support operator rollout
merge_outcome: Merged to main (squash) after approvals from Diego, Priya, and Samir. No rollback required during validation window.
release_notes: Feature: Add embargoed provenance ledger and release microdigest generator. Operators can now attach time-limited, auditable metadata to model intake; Console and release automation will show compact microdigests that summarize performance and metadata deltas. Config: registry.provenance.ttl_days (default 90). Security: signer key rotation tracked under ENG-4890.
notes: Follow-up work: ENG-4890 (key rotation), ENG-4912 (allow user-level read audit logs), and PM-213 (UI copy for embargo reasons). Deployed to canary cluster 2024-11-12 and promoted to prod 2024-11-12.
security_considerations: Embargoed fields are encrypted at rest and only decrypted by registry service when ACL permits. Signer key usage audited via KMS logs. No secrets stored in repo. Access to signed receipts honors role-based visibility. See docs/registry/embargoed-metadata.md for operator guidance.
